svg.title: A code editor that knows Laravel
svg.desc: A code editor that knows Laravel. A code editor in the app: Highlighting for PHP, Blade, JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML, Markdown, shell scripts and .env files. Completion that knows Laravel: Your models' attributes and relations, routes, views, config, translations, validation rules and Blade components. Problems as you type: PHP is checked by the application's own PHP as you type, with the message on hover and F2 to the next one. Jump anywhere: Ctrl-click a class to open it, see every usage of a method, go to any file, and search everywhere with a double Shift. Refactor with a preview: Rename across the application, extract a variable, and move classes between namespaces with their references updated. Formatting your way: Format with the project's own Pint or Prettier. Its .editorconfig, .prettierrc and pint.json always win. Git, built in: Changed lines in the gutter, changed files in the tree, the branch in the status line and the diff in a tab. Markdown, previewed: Markdown files show their rendered preview beside them, updated as you type, with code blocks in colour.
